rules.name: DpiTypeWidthAlignment
rules.description: Disallow 4-state types (integer, reg) in DPI-C declarations. 4-state types require complex svLogicVecVal structs in C; use 2-state portable types (int, longint, byte) for C99 ABI compatibility.

rules.name: ProprietaryVendorCalls
rules.description: Disallow unguarded simulator-proprietary system tasks ($vcdpluson, $fsdbDumpvars, $shm_open). Vendor-specific calls prevent Verification IP from running on other simulators.

rules.name: HardcodedHostPaths
rules.description: Disallow hardcoded absolute filesystem paths (/home/..., C:\...) in file operations ($readmemh, $fopen). Absolute paths break regression execution in containerized CI/CD pipelines.

rules.name: DirectMirrorSetWithoutWrite
rules.description: Flags direct reg.set(...) calls that update only software mirrors without issuing physical DUT write transactions.

rules.name: MissingBackdoorAccessPathDefinition
rules.description: Flags RAL backdoor path configuration routines called with an empty string or null path.

rules.name: IncompleteRegAdapter
rules.description: Flags uvm_reg_adapter subclasses whose bus2reg() never sets rw.status or whose reg2bus() never reads rw.kind. The register layer then reports every access as passed, or turns reads into writes (adapter pattern, MG-5.1).

rules.name: RegBlockNeverLocked
rules.description: Flags a top-level register block (held by an env or test, not by another block) on which lock_model() is never called. Until the model is locked, address maps are not built, so frontdoor accesses and get_reg_by_offset() fail.

rules.name: RalAddressCollision
rules.description: Detects duplicate/overlapping address offsets mapped in uvm_reg_block address maps. Address collisions cause silent register overwriting and hardware aliasing bugs.

rules.name: RalOrphanRegister
rules.description: Detects instantiated uvm_reg instances inside uvm_reg_block that are never mapped via default_map.add_reg(). Orphan registers cause frontdoor access failures and verify phantom memory.

rules.name: RalMapAddressIntervalOverlap
rules.description: Detects 1D address interval overlaps and register aliasing collisions within the same uvm_reg_map in a uvm_reg_block, preventing silent register corruption in hardware.

rules.name: RalPredictorAdapterWiring
rules.description: Verifies that all instantiated uvm_reg_predictor components have their .map property assigned in connect_phase. Without a map binding, explicit register prediction fails silently and register mirror values will never be updated during simulation.

rules.name: PlaintextKeyInLogs
rules.description: Detects plaintext logging of sensitive cryptographic assets (keys, seeds, secrets) via $sformatf/$display. Logging secrets compromises hardware security and violates ISO/SAE 21434 regression standards.

rules.name: RefArgumentNeverWritten
rules.description: Flags ref arguments that the routine only reads; declare them const ref so callers know they are not modified (clang-tidy readability-non-const-parameter). Virtual methods are skipped because overrides share the signature.

rules.name: OffByOneQueueIndex
rules.description: Detects out-of-bounds off-by-one queue and dynamic array indexing (e.g. 'q[q.size()]'). SystemVerilog silently returns uninitialized 'x/0 instead of raising an exception.

rules.name: AssociativeArrayMutatingRead
rules.description: Detects direct read lookups on associative arrays in expressions without checking exists(). In SystemVerilog (IEEE 1800 § 7.8.1), reading a missing key silently allocates and inserts it with a default value.

rules.name: LegacyRegWireInTestbench
rules.description: Discourages legacy 'reg' and 'wire' keywords in SystemVerilog testbenches in favor of 'logic'.

rules.name: IdenticalBranches
rules.description: Flags if/else and case branches whose bodies are token-identical to an earlier branch of the same statement (clang-tidy bugprone-branch-clone, Sonar S1871).

rules.name: RepeatedElseIfCondition
rules.description: Flags a condition that repeats an earlier condition of the same if/else-if chain, which makes the later branch dead (Sonar S1862).

rules.name: SelfAssignment
rules.description: Flags 'x = x' assignments, typically a constructor or setter whose argument shadows the property it was meant to set (clang-tidy bugprone-self-assignment, Sonar S1656).

rules.name: MismatchedFieldInCopyCompare
rules.description: In do_copy/do_compare and similar field-wise methods, flags a field of this object paired with a differently named field of the other object when the matching field exists.

rules.name: IntegerDivisionToReal
rules.description: Flags integer divisions whose result is used as a real value, which truncates before the conversion (Sonar S2184, SpotBugs ICAST_IDIV_CAST_TO_DOUBLE).

rules.name: RealEquality
rules.description: Flags == and != on real or shortreal operands, except against an exact zero (Sonar S1244, clang-tidy float equality).

rules.name: SuspiciousArgumentOrder
rules.description: Flags positional calls where an argument's name matches a different parameter of the callee, such as write(len, addr) for write(addr, len) (clang-tidy readability-suspicious-call-argument, Sonar S2234).

rules.name: ClockingBlockOutputReadSkew
rules.description: Disallows reading output signals of a clocking block. Clocking block outputs are drive-only; reading them samples post-skew driven values with simulation race conditions.

rules.name: CompilerError
rules.description: Reports the SystemVerilog compiler's errors (syntax, elaboration and type errors) as findings, so they appear in every report and in the editor next to the lint findings.

rules.name: CompilerWarning
rules.description: Reports the SystemVerilog compiler's warnings as findings (controlled with -W options).

rules.name: CircularThreadWaitDeadlock
rules.description: Detects circular lock acquisition orders and wait-for dependency cycles across concurrent threads in fork..join blocks, which cause guaranteed or probabilistic simulation deadlocks.

rules.name: PollingLoop
rules.description: Flags loops that test a flag or signal and wait a constant #delay between tests, instead of wait(), @ or an event (busy-wait smell, Sonar S2925).

rules.name: SharedWriteFromForks
rules.description: Flags class properties written in two or more branches of one fork, or in a join_none thread and in its parent, without a semaphore (SpotBugs IS2_INCONSISTENT_SYNC).

rules.name: DefineForConstant
rules.description: Flags `define macros whose body is only a number or a string, used as constants. A package parameter or localparam has a type and a scope; a macro is global to the rest of the compilation and can be redefined silently (MG-6.1).

rules.name: MacroAsRoutine
rules.description: Flags multi-statement code macros that use nothing only a macro can do: no token pasting, stringification, nested macros, `__FILE__, type arguments, declarations or return/break. A function or task would be type-checked and debuggable (MG-6.1). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: IfdefInReusableClass
rules.description: Flags `ifdef, `ifndef and `elsif inside class bodies, apart from simulator and UVM version shims. Compile-time switches multiply the variants of a class and cannot be chosen per instance; configuration can (MG-6.1).

rules.name: StringAsEnum
rules.description: Flags a string variable compared against three or more literals in one case statement or if/else-if chain. The values form an enumeration the compiler cannot check; a typo in any of them fails silently (Fowler 'primitive obsession', MG-6.2). String arguments are SV-CPL-001's.

rules.name: ManualBitFieldSlicing
rules.description: Flags a vector that is cut into three or more different fixed part-selects (hdr[7:0], hdr[15:8], hdr[31:16]). The field layout lives in scattered numbers; a packed struct names it once (MG-6.2). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: ImplicitEnumBaseType
rules.description: Flags enums in packages, classes and interfaces declared without a base type. They silently become 32-bit int, which wastes bits in packed items and no longer matches the width of the bus field they model (MG-6.3). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: LegacyIntegerType
rules.description: Flags the Verilog-1995 type 'integer' in class code. It is a 4-state 32-bit signed value; int (2-state) or an explicitly sized logic vector says what is meant (MG-6.3). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: FunctionOutputArguments
rules.description: Flags void class functions that hand their results back through output arguments. A return value, or a struct for several values, keeps the call an expression and makes the data flow visible (command-query separation, MG-6.3). Overrides are left alone, since their signature is fixed. Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: ConstantWaitCondition
rules.description: Flags 'wait()' statements with compile-time constant conditions (e.g., 'wait(0);', 'wait(1);'). 'wait(0);' deadlocks the simulation thread permanently, while 'wait(1);' executes instantaneously.

rules.name: SemaphoreZeroKey
rules.description: Flags semaphore method calls (sem.get(0), sem.put(0), sem.try_get(0)) passing non-positive key counts (<= 0).

rules.name: EventTriggerInAlwaysComb
rules.description: Disallows event triggers ('->' or '->>') inside always_comb blocks (IEEE 1800 § 9.2.2.2).

rules.name: UnboundedMailboxInstantiation
rules.description: Disallows instantiating unbounded mailboxes without a capacity limit to prevent memory bloat and missed producer-consumer synchronization.

rules.name: MutexTryGetWithoutCheck
rules.description: Flags non-blocking semaphore or mutex try_get() calls whose return status is ignored, which risks threads executing critical sections without holding the lock.

rules.name: WaitForkWithoutFork
rules.description: Flags 'wait fork;' statements in tasks or routines that contain no 'fork' blocks. Calling wait fork without spawning child processes can cause unintended hangs or dead code.

rules.name: DisableForkWithoutScope
rules.description: Disallows calling 'disable fork;' directly at task or routine scope without an enclosing isolating 'fork ... join' block.

rules.name: WaitModifiedInLoop
rules.description: Flags wait(...) statements inside loops where condition variables are never modified or assigned inside the loop body.

rules.name: ForkLoopVariableCapture
rules.description: Disallows referencing loop variables directly inside 'fork ... join_none' or 'join_any' blocks without an automatic local variable copy.

rules.name: BlockingEventTriggerInClockedBlock
rules.description: Disallows blocking event triggers (-> ev) inside clocked blocks; non-blocking triggers (->> ev) should be used instead.

rules.name: TautologicalCheckCompare
rules.description: Detects tautological comparison between identical expressions (e.g. 'act_pkt.data == act_pkt.data'). Self-comparisons in scoreboards and checks always evaluate to true, masking hardware bugs.

rules.name: NonShortCircuitLogical
rules.description: Disallows using bitwise AND ('&') or bitwise OR ('|') instead of logical short-circuiting operators ('&&', '||') inside conditional statements.

rules.name: CaseWithoutDefault
rules.description: Flags 'case', 'casex', and 'casez' statements that lack an explicit 'default:' fallback branch.

rules.name: AssignmentInExpression
rules.description: Disallows assignment expressions ('=' or compound assignments) inside conditional predicates or loop conditions.

rules.name: SelfComparison
rules.description: Disallows self-comparisons where an operand is compared to itself (e.g. a == a), which tautologically evaluates to constant true or false.

rules.name: CasexProhibited
rules.description: Disallows use of 'casex' statements. 'casex' treats unknown simulation 'x' values as wildcards, masking uninitialized logic bugs and timing errors.

rules.name: ModifyingLoopIndexInsideFor
rules.description: Flags modifications to the loop control variable inside a 'for' loop body. Mutating the loop index inside the body causes infinite loops, skipped iterations, and indexing errors.

rules.name: ProceduralAssignmentAsSubExpression
rules.description: Disallows embedded assignment expressions used as sub-expressions within conditionals or arithmetic operations.

rules.name: UnreferencedCovergroup
rules.description: Detects covergroups declared in classes or modules that are never instantiated with 'new()' or never sampled. Unreferenced covergroups contribute 0 coverage samples, creating silent verification blind spots.

rules.name: ZeroWeightCoverpoint
rules.description: Flags covergroups, coverpoints, or crosses configured with option.weight or type_option.weight set to 0. Zero-weight coverage constructs collect samples but contribute 0% to regression coverage closure.

rules.name: CrossSameCoverpoint
rules.description: Detects coverage cross constructs crossing a coverpoint with itself (cross cp_a, cp_a). Crossing a coverpoint with itself creates redundant diagonal bins that distort coverage calculation.

rules.name: IllegalBinOverlap
rules.description: Detects overlapping values between regular 'bins' and 'illegal_bins' or 'ignore_bins' within a coverpoint. Per IEEE 1800 § 19.5, regular bins must not overlap with illegal or ignore bins.

rules.name: UnboundedTransitionBins
rules.description: Transition sequences in coverpoint bins must not specify unbounded repetitions (e.g., [*1:$], [->1:$]). Unbounded transition sequences cause exponential memory growth in simulator coverage databases.

rules.name: CovergroupCrossBinExplosion
rules.description: Disallows crossing 3 or more coverpoints without 'ignore_bins' or 'binsof' exclusion filters. Unfiltered multi-way crosses cause combinatorial auto-bin explosion, leading to simulator memory exhaustion.

rules.name: EmptyCovergroup
rules.description: Flags covergroups declared with zero coverpoints and zero crosses. An empty covergroup collects no coverage data.

rules.name: CrossWithEmptyBins
rules.description: Detects degenerate covergroup cross constructs specifying fewer than 2 coverpoints or empty cross products.

rules.name: CoverpointDefaultBinHazard
rules.description: Flags non-ignoring 'default' bins in coverpoints that mask uncovered stimulus and give a false sense of coverage closure.

rules.name: CrossWithAllBinsIgnored
rules.description: Flags covergroup cross constructs where all defined bins are ignore_bins, producing vacuous 0-bin coverage metrics.

rules.name: AtLeastZeroOrNegative
rules.description: Flags option.at_least or type_option.at_least set to 0 or negative values in covergroups/coverpoints. IEEE 1800 § 19.5 requires at_least to be a positive integer >= 1.

rules.name: WideCoverpointWithoutBins
rules.description: Flags coverpoints that define no explicit bins and omit option.auto_bin_max. Default auto-binning creates 64 bins, producing misleading 100% coverage closure on wide vectors.

rules.name: IgnoreBinsOverlapsIllegalBins
rules.description: Flags coverage models where the same value or range is specified in both 'ignore_bins' and 'illegal_bins' within a coverpoint.

rules.name: CoverpointWeightZero
rules.description: Flags covergroups or coverpoints where 'option.weight' or 'type_option.weight' is set to 0, silently excluding it from coverage scores.

rules.name: MissingIffOnCovergroupClock
rules.description: Covergroups sampled by a clocking event should specify an 'iff' reset guard condition.

rules.name: OverlappingRangesInCoverpointBin
rules.description: Flags coverpoint bins containing overlapping numerical value ranges.

rules.name: UnreachableCoverBin
rules.description: Flags coverpoint bins whose values all lie outside the range of the coverpoint expression (for example bins {[16:31]} on a 4-bit value). Such a bin can never be hit.

rules.name: StringModeParameter
rules.description: Flags routines whose string argument is compared against two or more literals to choose what to do, as in do_op("read"). Caller and callee must agree on spellings the compiler never checks (control coupling, connascence of meaning, MG-2.4). Use an enum argument or separate routines. Overrides are left alone.

rules.name: UnusedVariable
rules.description: Local variables declared in tasks or functions should be referenced. Unused variables clutter code, consume memory, and often indicate incomplete logic.

rules.name: UnreachableStatementsPostReturn
rules.description: Detects unreachable statements appearing after an unconditional control-flow termination (return, break, continue). Dead code clutters verification environments and hides logic errors.

rules.name: AccidentalEmptyConditional
rules.description: Detects accidental semicolons immediately following if() or while() headers. An empty conditional branch causes subsequent blocks to execute unconditionally, introducing severe logic bugs.

rules.name: ConsecutiveDeadStore
rules.description: Detects consecutive assignments to the same variable where the initial value is immediately overwritten without being read. Dead stores waste CPU cycles and frequently reveal copy-paste logic bugs.

rules.name: UnreadClassProperty
rules.description: Flags class properties that are assigned or written to, but never read anywhere in the class. Unread properties indicate dead instrumentation or abandoned design state.

rules.name: UnwrittenClassProperty
rules.description: Flags non-rand class properties that lack an initializer, are read in methods, but never written or assigned. Unwritten properties always evaluate to uninitialized defaults, risking dead branches and silent logic bugs.

rules.name: UnusedPureRoutineResult
rules.description: Flags calls to pure functions or value-returning routines ($sformatf, $realtime, len, toupper, sum) used as standalone statements where the result is discarded.

rules.name: UnusedGenerateBlock
rules.description: Flags conditional statements or generate blocks with constant false conditions ('0') and no 'else' clause.

rules.name: EmptyAlwaysOrInitial
rules.description: Disallows initial, always, always_comb, always_ff, always_latch, or final procedural blocks with empty bodies.

rules.name: EmptyForkJoin
rules.description: Disallows empty fork...join, fork...join_any, or fork...join_none blocks that contain zero statements.

rules.name: EmptyTaskOrFunction
rules.description: Flags concrete, non-virtual, non-extern tasks and functions with empty bodies (zero statements). Empty routines cause useless call overhead and indicate incomplete or dead logic.

rules.name: UnreferencedParameter
rules.description: Flags parameter and localparam declarations that are never referenced within their scope or testbench. Unused parameters create clutter and indicate dead or abandoned configurations.

rules.name: UnusedRoutineArgument
rules.description: Flags task and function arguments that the body never uses (clang-tidy misc-unused-parameters, Pylint W0613). Virtual methods and overrides, phase methods, DPI routines and empty bodies are skipped.

rules.name: ProgramBlockDeprecation
rules.description: Disallow the obsolete SystemVerilog 'program' block. Modern verification architectures mandate 'module' with clocking blocks to prevent premature simulation termination.

rules.name: DefparamDeprecation
rules.description: Disallow 'defparam' statements. Parameter overrides must be specified directly on instance headers.

rules.name: LegacyAlwaysBlock
rules.description: Disallow untyped 'always' blocks. Enforces IEEE 1800 intent-specific blocks: always_comb, always_ff, or always_latch.

rules.name: RandomSystemFunction
rules.description: Disallow legacy Verilog '$random'. Replaced by '$urandom' and '$urandom_range' in IEEE 1800.

rules.name: ProceduralContinuousAssign
rules.description: Disallow procedural 'assign' and 'deassign' statements. Procedural continuous assignments are non-synthesizable and induce simulation race conditions.

rules.name: NonAnsiPortList
rules.description: Disallow obsolete non-ANSI port list declarations. Enforces modern ANSI-style inline port lists.

rules.name: IntraAssignmentDelay
rules.description: Disallows intra-assignment timing controls (e.g., a = #5 b; or a <= #5 b;) on procedural assignments. Intra-assignment delays cause simulation race conditions and are non-synthesizable.

rules.name: RepeatLoopWithoutTiming
rules.description: Flags repeat loops inside testbench tasks that contain no time-consuming statements (#, @, wait). Zero-delay repeat loops in tasks spin instantaneously in a single delta cycle, often indicating missing clock synchronization.

rules.name: ZeroTimeForeverLoop
rules.description: Flags forever loops whose body has no timing control, no task call and no exit, so the loop spins in zero simulation time and hangs the simulator.

rules.name: DrivingDuringReset
rules.description: Disallow driving virtual interface control signals without an active reset check or synchronization guard. Asserting handshake signals during reset violates physical bus protocols and corrupts hardware state.

rules.name: TypeSwitchByName
rules.description: Flags branching on get_type_name() compared with string literals instead of virtual dispatch (Sonar 'instanceof chains', open/closed principle).

rules.name: GodClass
rules.description: Flags classes that are very complex (WMC >= 47), use many other classes' data (ATFD > 5) and have low cohesion (TCC < 1/3): PMD's GodClass detection strategy.

rules.name: LowCohesion
rules.description: Flags classes whose methods split into two or more groups that share no fields and do not call each other (LCOM4 > 1): the class is really several classes.

rules.name: HighCoupling
rules.description: Flags classes other than envs and tests that reference more than 10 distinct user class types (CK coupling between objects, PMD CouplingBetweenObjects).

rules.name: DeepInheritance
rules.description: Flags classes with more than 3 user-defined ancestors above the UVM base class (CK depth of inheritance tree, Pylint too-many-ancestors).

rules.name: OverrideOnlyCallsSuper
rules.description: Flags overrides whose whole body is the super call with the same arguments, such as a connect_phase that only calls super.connect_phase(phase) (Pylint useless-parent-delegation, Sonar S1185). Constructors are kept.

rules.name: EmptyOverrideOfConcrete
rules.description: Flags an empty override of a user base-class method that has a body, which silently switches the inherited behavior off (Fowler 'refused bequest', Liskov substitution).

rules.name: MutablePackageState
rules.description: Flags non-const variables declared in packages. They are shared by every env instance and test in a run (clang-tidy cppcoreguidelines-avoid-non-const-global-variables).

rules.name: RepeatedEnumSwitch
rules.description: Flags an enum that is switched on with case in three or more classes, a sign that behavior per kind belongs in a polymorphic item or policy class (Fowler 'repeated switches'). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: QueryChangesState
rules.description: Flags functions named get_*, is_* or has_* that write class properties (command-query separation). get_next_* is allowed. Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: DuplicateMethodBody
rules.description: Detects identical or copy-pasted subroutine method bodies across different classes. Duplicated code should be refactored into shared base classes or utilities.

rules.name: CloneFragments
rules.description: Finds runs of three or more statements (at least 50 tokens) that appear in more than one place, also when variables and literals were renamed consistently. Macro calls count as written, not as their expansion, and called names must match; runs that repeat one short cycle of statements, like unrolled loops, are left out. Each pair of routines is reported once; whole identical method bodies are SV-DUP-001's, and files whose header says they are generated are left out (DRY, Type-1/2 clones, MG-7.1).

rules.name: DuplicatedConstraint
rules.description: Flags a constraint body repeated in two classes that do not inherit from each other. The rule then lives in two places and drifts; declare it once in a shared base class or a policy object (Fowler 'pull up', MG-7.1). SV-RND-011 covers repeats inside one class.

rules.name: RepeatedStringLiteral
rules.description: Flags a string literal, such as a report ID or a file name, written four or more times in the code. Config keys (UVM-CFG-008), instance names and class names are left out. One named constant keeps the copies in step (DRY, MG-7.1). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: CopiedAgentPackage
rules.description: Flags two packages whose classes have the same roles, fields and method bodies apart from renamed identifiers, for at least three classes and 80% of the classes in the larger package (classes with almost no code are not counted). They are one agent copied and renamed; a parameterized agent, or a shared base with small subclasses, keeps one copy to fix (DRY, MG-7.2). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: MutableObjectGetterLeak
rules.description: Disallows getter functions (get_*()) from returning direct references to mutable internal class object members. Returning mutable handles leaks encapsulation; return a clone or copy instead.

rules.name: FailureNotReported
rules.description: Flags randomize(), $cast(), uvm_config_db::get(), try_* and compare() status checks whose failure branch is empty or only reports below error severity (Sonar S108/S1166).

rules.name: UseAfterFailedNullCheck
rules.description: Flags a handle that a null check, a failed uvm_config_db::get() or a failed $cast() showed to be null, dereferenced later on the same path because the failure branch did not stop (SpotBugs NP_NULL_ON_SOME_PATH).

rules.name: ProcessTerminationInClass
rules.description: Flags $finish, $stop and $exit called from class methods. The run then skips the extract, check and report phases and the UVM report summary (Sonar S1147).

rules.name: Hotspot
rules.description: With --history: reports the files that are both complex (summed cyclomatic complexity of their routines) and often changed in git, the top five by complexity times commits. Such hotspots are where defects collect and where refactoring pays first (Tornhill, MG-9.2). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: ChangeCoupling
rules.description: With --history: reports two files in different packages that change together in at least three commits and in at least half of the commits touching either. The packages have a hidden dependency that their imports do not show; move the shared knowledge to one place (temporal coupling, MG-9.2). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: ZeroDelayEventWaitLoop
rules.description: Using wait(event.triggered) inside a loop without an intervening time-advancing delay (@ or #) causes a zero-delay infinite delta loop that hangs the simulator at 100% CPU.

rules.name: ForkInsideFunction
rules.description: Disallows spawning concurrent threads with 'fork ... join/join_any/join_none' inside functions. Functions must remain synchronous and instantaneous per IEEE 1800 § 13.4.4.

rules.name: NonExhaustiveEnumCase
rules.description: Case statement switching over an enum type does not explicitly handle all declared enum variants while using a default: arm. Catch-all default arms silently swallow newly added specification states and mask FSM decoder bugs.

rules.name: BlockingAssignmentToInterface
rules.description: Disallows blocking assignments ('=') when driving virtual interface or clocking block signals. Clocking blocks and synchronous interface signals must be driven with non-blocking drives ('<=') per IEEE 1800 § 14.16.

rules.name: TryPutIgnoredReturn
rules.description: Non-blocking IPC routines (try_put, try_get, try_peek) return a boolean status. Ignoring the return value silently drops transactions when queues are full or empty.

rules.name: EqualityWithXz
rules.description: Detects equality ('==', '!=') checks against 4-state unknown literals ('x, 'z). Logical equality against unknowns evaluates to 'x (false in branch conditions), silently masking bugs. Use case equality ('===', '!==') instead.

rules.name: BitSelectOutOfBounds
rules.description: Detects static out-of-bounds bit or element selects on vectors and arrays with fixed ranges. SystemVerilog silently returns 'x for out-of-bounds accesses without crashing, causing silent data corruption.

rules.name: UnsizedLiteralInConcat
rules.description: Disallow unbased unsized integer literals inside concatenations ({1, 0, data}). Per IEEE 1800 § 11.4.12, unbased constants expand to 32 bits each, causing unintended vector widening.

rules.name: PartSelectReversed
rules.description: Detects reversed or inverted part-select slicing on vectors (e.g. vec[0:7] on logic [7:0] vec). Part-select slicing bounds must match the declared vector endianness.

rules.name: NonBlockingInFunction
rules.description: Prohibits non-blocking assignments ('<=') inside functions. Functions execute in zero simulation time and must only use blocking assignments ('=') per IEEE 1800 § 13.4.4.

rules.name: ArrayLocatorEmptyQueueDeref
rules.description: Disallows immediate element dereferencing on array locator methods (e.g., q.find()[0]). Locator methods return an unpacked queue that may be empty, causing out-of-bounds runtime errors (IEEE 1800 § 7.12.1).

rules.name: LspConstraintContradiction
rules.description: Disallows unconditionally disabling inherited constraints via '.constraint_mode(0)' in derived classes. Disabling inherited constraints breaks base class contracts and violates the Liskov Substitution Principle (LSP).

rules.name: HeaderMacroLeak
rules.description: Macros defined inside header files (.svh) must be undef'd with `undef before the end of the file unless registered as public API macros. Leaking macros causes silent parameter overrides and compilation collisions.

rules.name: UnparenthesizedMacroArgument
rules.description: Flags expression macros that use an argument next to an operator without parentheses, or whose body is not wrapped in parentheses. `define DOUBLE(x) x*2 turns DOUBLE(a+1) into a+1*2; write `define DOUBLE(x) ((x)*2).

rules.name: CognitiveComplexity
rules.description: Flags routines whose Sonar cognitive complexity (nesting-weighted branching, with fork/join counted as nesting) exceeds the threshold (default 25; Sonar S3776).

rules.name: LongRoutine
rules.description: Flags routines with more statements than the threshold (default 100; clang-tidy readability-function-size, Checkstyle MethodLength).

rules.name: TooManyArguments
rules.description: Flags tasks and functions with more formal arguments than the threshold (default 7; Pylint R0913, Sonar S107). Overrides are judged at the base declaration only.

rules.name: DeepNesting
rules.description: Flags routines whose control structures nest deeper than the threshold (default 5; Checkstyle NestedIfDepth, clang-tidy readability-function-size NestingThreshold).

rules.name: ComplexCondition
rules.description: Flags conditions with more && / || operators than the threshold (default 5; Pylint R0916, Checkstyle BooleanExpressionComplexity).

rules.name: LargeClass
rules.description: Flags classes with more than 30 properties or 30 methods; config objects and sequence items may have 80 properties, register models are exempt (PMD TooManyFields and TooManyMethods, Pylint R0902/R0904).

rules.name: GlobalUnitPollution
rules.description: Disallow variables, nets, typedefs, tasks, and functions declared directly in the $unit compilation unit scope. Declarations outside a package or module cause cross-file namespace pollution and compile-order dependencies in multi-unit compilation.

rules.name: UvmComponentNamingConvention
rules.description: Enforces standard naming conventions for UVM components: classes derived from uvm_driver must end with '_driver', uvm_monitor with '_monitor', uvm_agent with '_agent', uvm_env with '_env', and uvm_test with '_test'.

rules.name: PackageNamingConvention
rules.description: Enforces that package identifiers end with '_pkg' (e.g., 'axi_pkg') to standardize namespaces.

rules.name: InterfaceNamingConvention
rules.description: Enforces that interface identifiers end with '_if' (e.g., 'axi_if') to standardize interface definitions.

rules.name: UvmClassTypeSuffix
rules.description: Enforces standard verification naming suffix conventions for classes extending UVM base components (e.g. _seq, _item, _driver, _monitor, _scoreboard, _env).

rules.name: ConfigurableNamingEngine
rules.description: Parameterizable naming convention engine validating regex, prefix, suffix, and casing conventions across packages, interfaces, UVM classes, covergroups, and constraints.

rules.name: PackageNaming
rules.description: Packages should end with '_pkg' for clean namespace identification.

rules.name: InterfaceNaming
rules.description: Interfaces should end with '_if' suffix.

rules.name: VirtualInterfaceNaming
rules.description: Virtual interface handles and typedefs should end with '_vif'.

rules.name: ClassNaming
rules.description: General classes should follow PascalCase naming conventions.

rules.name: CovergroupNaming
rules.description: Covergroup declarations must end with '_cg' suffix.

rules.name: CoverpointNaming
rules.description: Coverpoints should start with 'cp_' prefix.

rules.name: CrossNaming
rules.description: Cross coverages should start with 'cross_' or 'cx_' prefix.

rules.name: AssertionNaming
rules.description: Concurrent assertions should have labels ending with '_a' or '_assert'.

rules.name: ParameterNaming
rules.description: Parameters and constants should follow ALL_CAPS conventions.

rules.name: TypedefEnumNaming
rules.description: Enum typedefs should end with '_e' suffix.

rules.name: TypedefNaming
rules.description: User-defined typedefs should end with '_t' suffix.

rules.name: ConstraintNaming
rules.description: Class constraint blocks should end with '_c' suffix.

rules.name: CastTypeInspectionLadder
rules.description: Disallows cascading $cast ladders (3+ branches) inspecting object types. Type inspection ladders violate the Open-Closed Principle (OCP); use virtual polymorphic methods instead.

rules.name: NonVirtualMethodOverride
rules.description: Overriding a non-virtual method in a derived class breaks polymorphism when accessed via a base class handle.

rules.name: UncheckedDynamicCast
rules.description: The return value of $cast(dest, src) must be checked (e.g., in an if statement or assert) to prevent silent null-pointer dereferences on cast failures.

rules.name: MissingSuperNew
rules.description: Constructors in derived classes should explicitly invoke super.new(...) to ensure base class state is initialized.

rules.name: VariableShadowing
rules.description: Detects variable shadowing where a derived class property shadows a base class property, or a method argument / local variable shadows a class member property.

rules.name: VirtualCallInConstructor
rules.description: Never call virtual methods inside constructors. In SystemVerilog, base constructors execute before child members are initialized, resulting in child methods operating on uninitialized data.

rules.name: ClassShallowCopyAliasing
rules.description: Using shallow copy (new other_obj) on classes containing nested object handles creates shared references across independent transactions. Use deep copy or clone() instead.

rules.name: StaticMemberInUvmComponent
rules.description: Non-const static variable declared in a uvm_component subclass is shared across all instances simulation-wide. In multi-channel or multi-agent environments, instances will overwrite each other's state.

rules.name: NonVirtualInterfaceInClass
rules.description: Disallows declaring physical interface types inside classes without the 'virtual' keyword (IEEE 1800 § 25.9).

rules.name: EmptyVirtualMethodWithoutPure
rules.description: Flags virtual methods defined with empty bodies instead of being declared 'pure virtual' in abstract base classes.

rules.name: ClassInstantiationInLoop
rules.description: Disallows direct class instantiation via new() inside simulation loops to prevent heap contention and memory allocation overhead.

rules.name: DowncastWithoutDynamicCast
rules.description: Flags static casting syntax (e.g. DerivedClass'(base_handle)) applied to class objects. SystemVerilog requires dynamic casting via $cast() to verify runtime polymorphism.

rules.name: ChainedAssignmentAliasing
rules.description: Disallows chained assignment expressions (e.g. a = b = c;). Chained assignments create dangerous reference aliasing across class handles.

rules.name: AbstractClassInstantiation
rules.description: Disallows direct instantiation of abstract (virtual) classes via 'new()'. Only concrete derived classes can be instantiated.

rules.name: SuperNewNotFirstStatement
rules.description: Derived class constructors calling super.new(...) must invoke it as the very first procedural statement.

rules.name: VirtualMethodSignatureMismatch
rules.description: Virtual method overrides in derived classes must match the parameter count and signature of the base virtual method.

rules.name: FileClassNameMismatch
rules.description: Flags `include'd class files that define more than one top-level class, or whose one class is not named after the file (my_drv.svh holding my_driver). With one class per file, named after it, a class can be found from its name and reused on its own (MG-1.2).

rules.name: WildcardImportOutsidePackage
rules.description: Flags 'import pkg::*' at file ($unit) scope, and inside files that are `include'd into a package. Both leak names into code that never asked for them and hide where a dependency comes from (information hiding, MG-1.3).

rules.name: UnusedPackageImport
rules.description: Flags package imports that supply no name used in their scope. An unused import is a false dependency: the package is compiled first, changes to it look relevant, and names it exports can collide with local ones (common reuse principle, MG-1.3).

rules.name: PackageLayerInversion
rules.description: Flags a package that imports a package from a higher testbench layer, such as an agent package importing an env or test package. The lower package can then not be compiled or reused without the higher one (acyclic and stable dependencies, MG-1.1). UVM-ARC-001 checks the same order between classes.

rules.name: UnstablePackageDependedOn
rules.description: Computes instability I = Ce / (Ca + Ce) for each user package from its imports and flags a package that depends on a less stable one. Many packages rely on a stable package, so its own dependencies should be at least as stable (Martin's stable dependencies principle, MG-1.4). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: PassArrayByValue
rules.description: Passing dynamic arrays, queues, associative arrays, unpacked arrays, or unpacked structs by value (input) causes expensive memory duplication on every call. Use 'const ref' or 'ref' instead.

rules.name: ArrayReductionWidthTruncation
rules.description: Array reduction methods (.sum, .product) accumulate at element bit-width before extension to LHS. Summing sub-32-bit elements into 32/64-bit integers causes silent wraparound unless cast in with().

rules.name: DynArrayIncrementalResizeInLoop
rules.description: Growing dynamic arrays incrementally inside loops with new[arr.size()+1](arr) causes O(N^2) memory reallocation bottlenecks. Pre-allocate with new[N] or use SystemVerilog queues instead.

rules.name: ProceduralZeroDelay
rules.description: Procedural delay #0 reschedules execution into the Inactive region. Repeated #0 rescheduling causes delta-cycle thrashing and degrades simulation throughput.

rules.name: UnshieldedVerbosityFormatEval
rules.description: Calling $sformatf inside uvm_info/warning without checking uvm_report_enabled formats strings even when messages are discarded by verbosity.

rules.name: StringKeyAssociativeArray
rules.description: Detects associative arrays indexed by 'string'. String keys incur hash calculation and dynamic string comparisons on every lookup and insert, degrading simulation throughput.

rules.name: QueueConcatAppend
rules.description: Disallow queue concatenation ('q = {q, x}' or 'q = {x, q}'). Concatenation reallocates memory on every append ($O(N^2)$ in loops); use push_back() or push_front() for amortized $O(1)$ performance.

rules.name: QueueSlicePopFirst
rules.description: Disallow queue slicing ('q = q[1:$]') to drop head elements. Queue slicing duplicates all remaining elements into new memory; use pop_front() for in-place $O(1)$ head-pointer advance.

rules.name: NbaOnClassProperty
rules.description: Disallow non-blocking assignments ('<=') on class properties. For heap-allocated class instances, NBAs force the simulator kernel to create dynamic event descriptors in the NBA region of the event wheel. Use blocking assignment ('=').

rules.name: StringConcatInLoop
rules.description: Disallows iterative in-place string concatenation or $sformatf recursion inside loop bodies to prevent O(N^2) memory reallocation overhead.

rules.name: DynamicArrayNewInLoop
rules.description: Disallows dynamic array allocation (new[...]) inside simulation loops to prevent heap contention and memory churn.

rules.name: UnboundedDynamicArrayInConstraint
rules.description: Flags dynamic array or queue size constraints with an upper bound (< or <=) lacking an explicit lower bound.

rules.name: ZeroDelayEventTrigger
rules.description: Flags blocking event triggers ('-> event') which cause zero-delay simulation race conditions. Recommends non-blocking event triggers ('->> event') or persistent event evaluation ('wait(event.triggered)').

rules.name: PositionalFlagLiterals
rules.description: Flags calls that pass two or more 0/1 literals positionally to 1-bit arguments; use named argument binding (clang-tidy bugprone-argument-comment, Clean Code flag arguments).

rules.name: MagicNumber
rules.description: Flags numeric literals other than 0, 1 and -1 in class method bodies: conditions, loop bounds and sizes; delays are left to the magic-delay rules (Checkstyle MagicNumber, Sonar S109). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: CommentedOutCode
rules.description: Flags blocks of // comments that parse as SystemVerilog statements or declarations (Sonar S125). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: UndocumentedExtensionPoint
rules.description: Flags new virtual methods without a preceding comment in classes meant to be extended: classes with user subclasses, classes named *base*, and callbacks (Checkstyle MissingJavadocMethod, Pylint C0116). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: RedundantBoolean
rules.description: Flags 1-bit values compared with 1'b1/1'b0 and 'if (c) return 1; else return 0;' (Sonar S1125, clang-tidy readability-simplify-boolean-expr). Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: UncheckedRandomize
rules.description: The return value of randomize() must be checked. Silently ignoring failure leaves transactions un-randomized or corrupt, concealing verification testbench bugs.

rules.name: GlobalRngInClass
rules.description: Calling $urandom or $random inside class components or sequences corrupts global thread random stability. Use std::randomize() or object-scoped randomization to preserve simulation repeatability.

rules.name: RandomizeMissingSuper
rules.description: Overridden pre_randomize() and post_randomize() callback methods must invoke super.pre_randomize() or super.post_randomize() to prevent bypassing base-class transaction setup and validation routines.

rules.name: InlineShadowNoLocal
rules.description: Detects inline constraint variable shadowing inside 'randomize() with' missing 'local::'. Unqualified identifiers resolve to target object properties, turning constraints into no-op tautologies.

rules.name: NonRandFieldConstrained
rules.description: Detects class member fields that are constrained in a constraint block but not declared 'rand' or 'randc'. The solver treats non-rand fields as fixed constants and will never randomize them.

rules.name: RandcMemoryExplosion
rules.description: Disallow wide vector declarations with 'randc' (> 16 bits). Cyclic permutation tracking across large state spaces causes simulator heap exhaustion and solver startup deadlocks.

rules.name: NonInvertibleConstraintOp
rules.description: Disallow non-invertible operators (%, /, **) inside constraint blocks. Non-linear operators prevent SAT/SMT solvers from bi-directionally pruning solution spaces, causing catastrophic backtracking and long simulation stalls.

rules.name: StaticConstraint
rules.description: Disallows static constraints. Static constraints share solver state across all class instances in the simulation, causing hidden dependencies and test flakiness.

rules.name: CyclicSolveBefore
rules.description: Detects cyclic dependencies in solve...before constraint ordering (e.g. solve a before b and solve b before a). Cyclic solve-before constraints create an unsatisfiable dependency graph in the solver.

rules.name: RedundantConstraint
rules.description: Detects duplicate or redundant constraint expressions within the same class scope. Redundant constraints enlarge solver expression graphs and increase solver solve latency without adding constraints.

rules.name: ZeroWeightDistribution
rules.description: Detects constraint distribution blocks where all weights evaluate to zero. At least one weight in a distribution must evaluate to non-zero per IEEE 1800 § 18.5.4.

rules.name: UnrestoredRandMode
rules.description: Flags '.rand_mode(0)' or '.constraint_mode(0)' calls that are never restored with '1' in the routine. Unrestored disabled random modes permanently corrupt stimulus generation for subsequent transactions.

rules.name: EmptyRandomizeWith
rules.description: Flags 'randomize() with {}' containing an empty inline constraint block. Empty inline constraint blocks incur dynamic solver scope allocation overhead while adding no constraints.

rules.name: UnconstrainedRandVariable
rules.description: Flags non-static 'rand' class properties that are never constrained in any constraint block within the class.

rules.name: ConcurrentRandomizeInFork
rules.description: Disallows concurrent calls to .randomize() on the same object handle across parallel fork threads without synchronization.

rules.name: RandcStateExhaustion
rules.description: Flags 'randc' cyclic variables declared with bit-width <= 2 bits (1 or 2 bits). State permutation tables for <= 4 states reset almost immediately, incurring solver overhead with no benefit.

rules.name: RandomizeInConstructor
rules.description: Disallows calling randomize() inside class constructors (new()). Randomizing during construction breaks derived-class constraint inheritance and factory overrides.

rules.name: ConstraintImplicationMultiBit
rules.description: Flags constraint implication expressions 'A -> B' where condition 'A' is a multi-bit vector without an explicit boolean comparison.

rules.name: RandcInDynamicContainer
rules.description: Disallows declaring 'randc' cyclic variables on dynamic arrays, queues, or associative arrays (IEEE 1800 § 18.4.1).

rules.name: ConstraintInsideInvertedRange
rules.description: Disallows inverted value ranges [low : high] where low > high in set membership expressions.

rules.name: ConstraintCallingNonPureFunction
rules.description: Functions called in constraints must be pure and must not have side effects or void return types.

rules.name: UnallocatedRandObjectArray
rules.description: Flags rand arrays of class handles whose elements are never created. randomize() sizes a dynamic array but does not construct objects, so every element stays null and its rand members are never randomized.

rules.name: LockNotReleased
rules.description: Flags semaphore get()/try_get() and sequencer lock()/grab() that some path leaves without the matching put()/unlock()/ungrab(), such as an early return (Sonar S2222).

rules.name: FileHandleNotClosed
rules.description: Flags $fopen calls in classes that never call $fclose, which loses buffered trace data and exhausts file handles in long regressions (Sonar S2095).

rules.name: ForeachLoopVariableShadowing
rules.description: Flags loop index variables in 'foreach (arr[i])' loops that shadow an existing class property or routine local variable.

rules.name: ScratchpadClassProperty
rules.description: Disallow declaring scratchpad variables or loop induction counters as class properties. Move declarations to method stack frames to ensure thread safety and re-entrancy.

rules.name: MagicDelayInSequence
rules.description: Disallow hardcoded physical delays (#delay) inside uvm_sequence. Sequences must be clocking-block and frequency agnostic.

rules.name: GenericReportId
rules.description: Disallow generic single-word report IDs ('ERR', 'INFO', 'DEBUG') in UVM reporting macros. Use feature-scoped hierarchical identifiers to support precise log filtering.

rules.name: CyclomaticComplexityGodMethod
rules.description: Detects subroutines with high McCabe Cyclomatic Complexity ($M > 15$). Complex control flow obscures edge cases and inhibits functional verification.

rules.name: StreamingConcatenationSizeMismatch
rules.description: Disallows streaming concatenation operators ({>> { ... }} / {<< { ... }}) without explicit slice size. Unbounded slice streaming leads to silent truncation and byte alignment bugs per IEEE 1800 § 11.4.14.

rules.name: ClassMemberPrefix
rules.description: Enforces that member properties of uvm_component classes begin with 'm_' prefix to distinguish local member state from arguments and parameters.

rules.name: MacroTrailingSemicolon
rules.description: Flags unnecessary semicolons following `uvm_* macro invocations that create empty statements in declarative or procedural scopes.

rules.name: TodoCommentTracker
rules.description: Tracks unresolved TODO, FIXME, ICEBOX, HACK, and XXX comment markers across the codebase. Ensures temporary developer placeholders are addressed before tape-out or milestone delivery.

rules.name: TypedefNameSuffix
rules.description: Enforces naming conventions for typedefs: enums must end with '_e', and structs/data types must end with '_t'.

rules.name: MandatoryMatchingEndLabel
rules.description: Enforces explicit and matching end labels on functions, tasks, and classes (e.g., endfunction : name). Prevents scope delimiter ambiguity in large verification codebases.

rules.name: MismatchedEndLabel
rules.description: Flags mismatched end labels on functions, tasks, and classes (e.g., function void foo(); ... endfunction : bar). Prevents scope delimiter confusion and copy-paste errors.

rules.name: MethodBannerStyle
rules.description: Standardizes method separator pre-banners. Enforces 70–80 character uniform dashed separator lines and flags ragged or arbitrary-width comment separators.

rules.name: SectionHeaderBanner
rules.description: Standardizes major section divider banners to uniform 70–80 character widths. Prevents ragged ASCII banners across verification packages and testbench files.

rules.name: ExternMethodThreshold
rules.description: Enforces 'extern' declaration for class methods exceeding N lines of code (default: 5 lines). Keeps class declarations concise and readable as clean interface definitions.

rules.name: ExplicitLiteralWidth
rules.description: Disallow unsized integer and numeric literals without explicit bit-width declarations. Prevents silent 32-bit zero-extension and sign extension bugs.

rules.name: OneStatementPerLine
rules.description: Prohibit multiple procedural statements on the same line separated by semicolons. Enforces clean formatting and deterministic single-stepping in simulation debuggers.

rules.name: SpaceKeywordParen
rules.description: Requires a single space between control keywords (if, for, foreach, while, case) and opening parenthesis. Enforces common SystemVerilog code formatting guidelines.

rules.name: IncludeGuard
rules.description: Every included header file (.svh) must be wrapped in standard macro include guards (`ifndef / `define / `endif) to prevent circular definitions and compiler redefinition errors.

rules.name: TrailingWhitespace
rules.description: Disallows trailing whitespace (spaces and tabs) at the end of lines in source files.

rules.name: MaxLineLength
rules.description: Flags source lines exceeding 120 characters (option: max_columns) to preserve readability across split-view editors and terminal reviews.

rules.name: ConfigurableStyleEngine
rules.description: Parameterizable code style engine enforcing tab prohibitions, trailing whitespace limits, maximum line lengths, matching block end labels, and file naming.

rules.name: NoTabs
rules.description: Literal tab characters are not allowed (style.allow_tabs).

rules.name: NoTrailingWhitespace
rules.description: Lines must not end in whitespace (style.allow_trailing_whitespace).

rules.name: MaxLineLength
rules.description: Lines must not exceed style.max_line_length characters.

rules.name: MatchingEndLabel
rules.description: Blocks, routines and classes carry an end label that matches their name (style.mandatory_matching_end_label).

rules.name: FileMatchesClassName
rules.description: A file's base name matches the top-level class it defines.

rules.name: FileHeader
rules.description: Files start with a header matching style.file_header_pattern (style.require_file_header).

rules.name: ImmediateAssertInCombinatorialLogic
rules.description: Simple immediate assertions in always_comb or combinatorial blocks evaluate transient delta glitches. Convert to deferred immediate assertions (assert #0 or assert final) to wait for settled circuit values.

rules.name: DisableIffComplexExpression
rules.description: Flags 'disable iff (...)' clauses containing complex boolean expressions or multi-variable logic instead of simple reset conditions.

rules.name: MixedClockEdgesInProperty
rules.description: Flags SVA properties or assertions that mix both 'posedge' and 'negedge' clocking events.

rules.name: NonConsecutiveRepetitionZeroBound
rules.description: Non-consecutive repetition operators ([= ...] and [-> ...]) must specify a minimum bound >= 1.

rules.name: MultiClockConcurrentAssertionDomain
rules.description: Disallows concurrent assertions mixing multiple asynchronous clock domains without formal CDC qualification.

rules.name: UncheckedFopen
rules.description: Flags unchecked $fopen return descriptors and discarded $fopen calls. File operations must check whether the descriptor is valid before performing file I/O.

rules.name: ForkLoopVariableShared
rules.description: Spawning background threads with fork..join_none inside loops without copying the loop variable to an automatic local variable causes all threads to see the final loop index.

rules.name: StaticRoutineVariableLifetime
rules.description: Non-class tasks and functions default to static lifetime in SystemVerilog. Local variables in static routines share memory addresses across concurrent calls, leading to intermittent corruption.

rules.name: UnboundedThreadSpawn
rules.description: Flags fork ... join_none inside forever or while loops with no wait fork, disable fork or semaphore get in the loop to bound outstanding threads (thread-leak checks).

rules.name: TimescalePrecisionMismatch
rules.description: Flags `timescale directives where the time precision is coarser than the time unit (IEEE 1800 § 3.14.2).

rules.name: MissingTimescaleInModule
rules.description: Flags files and modules containing procedural delays (#) that lack an explicit `timescale or timeunit declaration.

rules.name: ConstantReseed
rules.description: Flags srandom() or set_randstate() with a constant in components, sequences and other non-test classes; every seed of the regression then runs the same stimulus. Advisory: off by default.

rules.name: MixedSignComparison
rules.description: Comparing signed and unsigned integers causes implicit unsigned coercion of the signed operand. Negative values evaluate as huge positive numbers, causing comparisons to silently invert logic.

rules.name: RedundantCastToSameType
rules.description: Flags dynamic '$cast' calls or static type casts where the source and destination already have identical static types.

rules.name: ArrayLiteralSizeMismatch
rules.description: Flags positional array assignment patterns '{...} where the number of elements does not match the target fixed array dimension.

rules.name: TaskWithNonVoidReturnType
rules.description: Disallows declaring tasks with explicit non-void return types.

rules.name: AssertWithoutElse
rules.description: Immediate and concurrent assertions must include an 'else' action block (e.g. 'else `uvm_error(...)'). Assertions without action blocks produce unhelpful one-line messages and cannot integrate with UVM reporting.

rules.name: TimeInAssertionAction
rules.description: Action blocks of immediate and concurrent assertions must not consume simulation time (# delays, @ event controls, or wait statements) per IEEE 1800 § 16.

rules.name: ConcurrentAssertInFunction
rules.description: Disallow concurrent assertions ('assert/assume/cover property') inside functions. Functions execute in zero simulation time and lack clocking contexts required by SVA semantics.

rules.name: SvaUnboundedDelay
rules.description: Disallow unbounded cycle delays (##[1:$]) in SVA sequences. Unbounded delays cause simulator memory thread leaks and formal verification state-space explosions.

rules.name: UnlabeledAssertion
rules.description: Immediate and concurrent assertions must declare an explicit label prefix (e.g. 'check_lbl: assert ...'). Lacking labels makes regression failure triage, ticket routing, and assertion control commands difficult.

rules.name: DisableIffReset
rules.description: Concurrent assertions and property declarations must include a 'disable iff (!rst_n)' clause to gate checking during power-on reset and warm resets, avoiding false-failure storms.

rules.name: SvaVacuousAntecedent
rules.description: Detects constant-false antecedents in assertion implications (0 |-> ...). False antecedents cause vacuous passes, giving a false 100% pass metric while never verifying DUT behavior.

rules.name: UvmTransactionAliasing
rules.description: Disallows in-place mutation of transaction objects after broadcasting via an analysis port (.write()). Analysis ports pass shared references; subsequent in-place mutations corrupt downstream scoreboards and subscribers.

rules.name: LayerDependency
rules.description: Flags classes that depend on a higher testbench layer (item < sequence < agent < env < test), such as a sequence that references a scoreboard or an agent that references the env (ArchUnit layer rules).

rules.name: HierarchyReachThrough
rules.description: Flags expressions that reach through three or more component handles (env.agt.drv.vif), outside connect_phase wiring (PMD LawOfDemeter, Fowler 'message chains').

rules.name: FileIncludedInMultiplePackages
rules.description: Flags a file whose class definitions are `include'd into more than one package. Each package gets its own, incompatible type with the same name (C++ one-definition rule).

rules.name: StringHierarchyLookup
rules.description: Flags uvm_root/uvm_component find(), find_all() and lookup() calls outside tests and end_of_elaboration_phase. Looking components up by path string is a service locator that hides dependencies and breaks silently when the hierarchy changes.

rules.name: UvmBannedFieldMacros
rules.description: Bans the `uvm_field_* macro suite. Mandates manual do_copy, do_compare, and do_print methods to eliminate severe simulation performance overhead and uncontrollable deep copy bugs.

rules.name: UvmBannedUvmDoMacros
rules.description: Discourages black-box `uvm_do macros in sequence bodies. Mandates explicit start_item / finish_item transaction handshakes.

rules.name: DirectDoMethodCall
rules.description: Flags direct calls to do_copy, do_compare, do_print, do_pack, do_unpack and do_record. These are hooks for the public copy/compare/print/pack/record methods; calling them directly bypasses the policy object. super.do_*() inside an override is allowed.

rules.name: UvmConfigDbTypeMismatch
rules.description: The type parameter in uvm_config_db#(T)::get must match the type parameter used in the corresponding set call for the same field name.

rules.name: UvmConfigDbNullContext
rules.description: Passing 'null' as context to uvm_config_db inside a uvm_component breaks hierarchical scoping and prevents targeted configuration overrides. Use 'this' instead.

rules.name: UvmConfigDbGlobalWildcard
rules.description: Calling uvm_config_db::set(null, "*", ...) with a null context and a bare wildcard or empty scope triggers global regex matching across every component in the testbench, severely degrading simulation startup.

rules.name: ConfigDbGetUnchecked
rules.description: Flags calls to 'uvm_config_db#(...)::get()' where the boolean return status is ignored without being checked in an 'if' condition or assertion.

rules.name: ConfigDbCrossComponentResolver
rules.description: Performs cross-component semantic resolution on uvm_config_db calls across the testbench hierarchy DAG to detect configuration type mismatches between set() and get() calls.

rules.name: PlusargsOutsideTest
rules.description: Flags $test$plusargs, $value$plusargs and uvm_cmdline_processor reads in classes other than tests and config objects. Reading the command line deep inside components is hidden global configuration.

rules.name: ConfigDbAsRuntimeChannel
rules.description: Flags uvm_config_db get, set, exists and wait_modified calls in the run-time phases of components and inside loops of any task. config_db is build-time wiring; used at run time it becomes a slow global mailbox (common coupling, MG-2.3).

rules.name: ScatteredConfigKeyLiteral
rules.description: Flags a uvm_config_db field name typed as a string literal in two or more files. The setter and getter only meet if both spell it the same; a shared constant makes the compiler check that (connascence of name, MG-2.4). Reported once per name.

rules.name: SharedConfigMutatedAtRuntime
rules.description: Flags writes to fields of a config object that the class got from uvm_config_db and did not create, made outside new() and the build phases. The object is shared by everyone who read it, so the write is hidden global state (common coupling, MG-2.3).

rules.name: HandleToEnvOrTest
rules.description: Flags sequences, items, agents, config objects and helpers that store a handle to a user env or test class. They then depend on everything the env contains and cannot be used under another env (stamp coupling, dependency inversion, MG-2.1).

rules.name: ForeignComponentStateWrite
rules.description: Flags assignments to properties of another component through a handle, except a parent setting up its own subtree in new() and the build, connect and end_of_elaboration phases (content coupling, MG-2.1). UVM-ARC-002 covers long read chains.

rules.name: HierarchicalReferenceInClass
rules.description: Flags class code that names a module hierarchy (tb_top.dut.sig, $root.tb.x). Classes must reach the DUT only through virtual interfaces so they stay reusable (information hiding, MG-2.2).

rules.name: UvmDanglingConfigString
rules.description: Static UVM component DAG path matching: detects glob strings in uvm_config_db::set() that match zero instantiated components in the verification hierarchy. Typographical errors in string paths cause configurations to be silently dropped.

rules.name: UvmDeprecatedConfigCalls
rules.description: Disallow deprecated legacy set_config_* and get_config_* methods (IEEE 1800.2 Annex H). Use type-safe uvm_config_db#(T)::set/get.

rules.name: UvmDeprecatedReportServer
rules.description: Disallow direct singleton calls to uvm_report_server::get_server() (IEEE 1800.2 Annex H). Obtain report servers through uvm_coreservice_t.

rules.name: UvmDeprecatedPrinterKnobs
rules.description: Disallow direct access to 'printer.knobs' (IEEE 1800.2 § 5.5.2). Use accessor methods on uvm_printer.

rules.name: UvmDeprecatedTestDone
rules.description: Disallow obsolete OVM 'uvm_test_done' objection handle (IEEE 1800.2 Annex H). Attach objections to the active phase parameter.

rules.name: UvmComponentDirectNew
rules.description: UVM components must be created using the UVM factory (type_name::type_id::create) instead of direct new() calls to support testbench overrides.

rules.name: UvmFactoryMacroMismatch
rules.description: Classes derived from uvm_component must use `uvm_component_utils, and classes derived from uvm_object (non-component) must use `uvm_object_utils.

rules.name: UvmFactoryMissingUtils
rules.description: Concrete classes derived from uvm_object or uvm_component must declare factory registration macros (`uvm_component_utils / `uvm_object_utils).

rules.name: ParameterizedClassFactoryRegistration
rules.description: Parameterized UVM components and objects must use `uvm_component_param_utils or `uvm_object_param_utils instead of non-parameterized utils macros.

rules.name: GlobalFactoryOverridePollution
rules.description: Flags global factory type overrides (set_type_override, set_type_override_by_type, factory.set_type_override_by_name, T::type_id::set_type_override) outside uvm_test classes. They change the type for every test and VIP in the simulation; reusable components and sequences should use instance overrides scoped to their sub-tree.

rules.name: ProhibitedDisplayInUvm
rules.description: Disallow direct $display/$write/$strobe calls inside UVM classes (components, objects, sequences). SystemVerilog display tasks bypass UVM reporting infrastructure, log redirection, and verbosity filtering.

rules.name: UvmDriverNaming
rules.description: UVM driver components must end with '_driver' or '_drv'.

rules.name: UvmMonitorNaming
rules.description: UVM monitor components must end with '_monitor' or '_mon'.

rules.name: UvmSequencerNaming
rules.description: UVM sequencers must end with '_sequencer' or '_sqr'.

rules.name: UvmSequenceNaming
rules.description: UVM sequence classes must end with '_seq' or '_sequence'.

rules.name: UvmSequenceItemNaming
rules.description: UVM transaction/sequence items must end with '_item' or '_seq_item'.

rules.name: UvmAgentNaming
rules.description: UVM agents must end with '_agent' suffix.

rules.name: UvmEnvNaming
rules.description: UVM environments must end with '_env' suffix.

rules.name: UvmTestNaming
rules.description: UVM test classes must end with '_test' suffix.

rules.name: UvmScoreboardNaming
rules.description: UVM scoreboards must end with '_scoreboard' or '_scb'.

rules.name: UvmUnpairedObjection
rules.description: Every phase.raise_objection() call must have a corresponding phase.drop_objection() within the same execution context to prevent simulation hangs or fatal errors.

rules.name: UvmObjectionInLoop
rules.description: Avoid raising and dropping objections inside high-frequency transaction loops to prevent severe simulation performance degradation.

rules.name: ObjectionControlFlowMismatch
rules.description: Performs control-flow graph (CFG) analysis on UVM phase and task routines to verify that every execution path containing raise_objection() is strictly guaranteed to reach a matching drop_objection() without early returns or asymmetric conditional branching.

rules.name: OrphanSubsequenceObjectionHang
rules.description: Detects background processes launched via fork..join_none inside UVM sequences that raise objections without a deterministic drop path, leaving orphan objections that hang simulation phases.

rules.name: ObserverStateMutationInWrite
rules.description: Mutating the observed transaction object inside a subscriber's write() method corrupts state for other concurrent subscribers in the Observer pattern. Clone the transaction before mutating.

rules.name: BlockingInObserver
rules.description: Analysis write() implementations (uvm_subscriber::write and the write<SFX> methods behind uvm_analysis_imp<SFX>) must be functions that finish in zero time. Flags a write declared as a task, and a write that forks a thread per transaction.

rules.name: CallbackNotRegistered
rules.description: Flags `uvm_do_callbacks(T, CB, ...) in classes where no `uvm_register_cb(T, CB) registers that pair for T or a base of T. UVM then refuses to add callbacks of that type at run time, so the hook never fires (MG-5.1).

rules.name: HandRolledSingleton
rules.description: Flags a class that keeps a static variable of its own type, the usual hand-rolled singleton. Every env and test in the run shares that one object, and a test cannot replace it. Pass the object through uvm_config_db or the resource database (MG-5.3).

rules.name: UvmMissingSuperPhase
rules.description: Overridden standard UVM phases (e.g., build_phase, connect_phase) in uvm_component must call super.<phase_name>(phase) to ensure proper base-class configuration.

rules.name: UvmTimeInFunctionPhase
rules.description: Function-based UVM phases (e.g., build_phase, connect_phase) must not consume simulation time using delays (#), event controls (@), or wait statements.

rules.name: UvmPhaseSignatureMismatch
rules.description: Standard UVM phase methods must declare correct signatures (function void vs task, and a single argument of type uvm_phase).

rules.name: SequenceInFunctionPhase
rules.description: Disallow starting sequences (.start()) inside zero-time function phases (build_phase, connect_phase, etc.). Sequences require time-consuming simulation events and must be executed in task phases.

rules.name: SuperBuildPhaseOrder
rules.description: Enforces that super.build_phase(phase) is the very first procedural statement in build_phase. Top-down phasing requires base class build_phase to execute before derived class configuration logic.

rules.name: PhaseObjectionMismatch
rules.description: Detects 'phase.raise_objection()' calls without a matching 'phase.drop_objection()' in the same task or method. Unpaired objections prevent UVM phases from terminating, causing simulation hangs.

rules.name: UvmPhaseJumpHazard
rules.description: Disallows manual phase jumping ('phase.jump(...)') in UVM testbenches due to objection leaks and scoreboard desynchronization risks.

rules.name: TimeInNonTimePhase
rules.description: Disallows time-consuming statements (#, @, wait, ##) inside non-time-consuming UVM phases (e.g. build_phase, connect_phase, check_phase).

rules.name: ObjectionInNonRunPhase
rules.description: Disallows calling raise_objection() or drop_objection() inside non-run function phases (e.g. build_phase, connect_phase). Objections are strictly reserved for runtime phases.

rules.name: BuildPhaseCrossComponentAccess
rules.description: Detects direct access to sibling components or cross-component handles during build_phase. Because the execution order of build_phase among sibling components is undefined in UVM, referencing sibling state during build_phase results in non-deterministic initialization races.

rules.name: DirectRalMirrorTampering
rules.description: Direct assignment to internal RAL fields (m_value, m_mirrored, m_desired) bypasses register callbacks, access policy checks, and prediction pipelines. Use predict() or bus operations instead.

rules.name: LowVerbosityDebugReport
rules.description: Flags UVM debug or trace messages configured with low verbosity (UVM_LOW or UVM_NONE).

rules.name: BlanketErrorDemotion
rules.description: Flags report catchers that demote or swallow errors without filtering on ID or message, and severity overrides/actions that disable UVM_ERROR or UVM_FATAL for every ID (Pylint W0718 broad-exception-caught).

rules.name: CheckFailureAsWarning
rules.description: Flags a failed compare() or an expected-versus-actual mismatch reported only with `uvm_warning or `uvm_info. The test still passes; check failures must be errors so they are counted (MG-8.1).

rules.name: FatalInCheckerPath
rules.description: Flags `uvm_fatal on a data mismatch in scoreboards and subscribers. The run stops at the first mismatch and hides how many others there are; use `uvm_error and let max_quit_count stop the run (MG-8.1).

rules.name: InfoAtNoneVerbosity
rules.description: Flags `uvm_info messages at UVM_NONE verbosity, which cannot be filtered with +UVM_VERBOSITY. Experimental: measuring how often real benches use UVM_NONE on purpose.

rules.name: DriverGeneratesStimulus
rules.description: Flags drivers that randomize sequence items or start sequences. Stimulus belongs in sequences, where tests can layer constraints and the sequencer can arbitrate; a driver only converts items to pin activity (single responsibility, MG-3.1).

rules.name: CoverageOutsideObservers
rules.description: Flags covergroups declared in drivers and sequences. They sample what was intended, not what reached the DUT, and disappear when the agent is passive; collect coverage in a monitor or subscriber (MG-3.1).

rules.name: DutCheckingInAgent
rules.description: Flags agents that hold a scoreboard, predictor or reference model. Agents carry protocol knowledge only; DUT-specific checking belongs in the env so the agent can be reused with other DUTs (MG-3.2).

rules.name: TestBuildsLeafComponents
rules.description: Flags tests that create drivers, monitors, sequencers, agents, scoreboards or subscribers directly. Tests configure and select; the env builds, so every test shares one structure (facade, MG-3.3).

rules.name: MonitorDependsOnActivePath
rules.description: Flags monitors that hold a handle to a driver, sequencer or sequence item port. A monitor must work on its own, observing only the interface, or it breaks in passive agents (MG-3.1).

rules.name: AgentIgnoresIsActive
rules.description: Flags agents that create their driver or sequencer without checking is_active or get_is_active(). Such an agent cannot be reused as a passive monitor in a larger env (MG-4.1).

rules.name: AgentWithoutConfigObject
rules.description: Flags agents and envs that read three or more separate scalar settings from uvm_config_db instead of one config object (Fowler 'data clumps', MG-4.2).

rules.name: HardcodedTopology
rules.description: Flags envs that create components in a loop with a literal count instead of a count from their config object (open/closed principle, MG-4.2).

rules.name: AbsoluteConfigDbPath
rules.description: Flags uvm_config_db calls in classes whose path starts at uvm_test_top. Below the test the path should be relative to 'this'; with a non-null context an absolute path is appended to the context and never matches (MG-4.3).

rules.name: OverrideByNameString
rules.description: Flags factory overrides and creates that name types with string literals (set_type_override_by_name, set_inst_override, create_object ...). A typo or rename is only found at run time; T::type_id::set_type_override() is checked by the compiler (connascence of name, MG-4.3).

rules.name: IncompleteItemContract
rules.description: Flags concrete sequence items with fields that implement neither field macros nor do_copy(), do_compare() and convert2string()/do_print(). Scoreboards, clone() and debug prints then silently see default behaviour (MG-4.4).

rules.name: ScoreboardSilentDrop
rules.description: Detects silent returns in scoreboard write methods when expected queues are empty without logging an error. Spurious or unpredicted DUT packets are dropped, hiding hardware bugs.

rules.name: ScoreboardLeftoverQueue
rules.description: Scoreboard expected transaction queues must be checked for drain completeness in check_phase or report_phase. Missing drain checks allow dropped DUT packets to pass silently.

rules.name: UvmSequenceDirectVifAccess
rules.description: Sequences and sequence items must not directly declare or drive virtual interface signals. Signal-level driving is the sole responsibility of the driver.

rules.name: UvmSequencePrePostBodyMisuse
rules.description: pre_body() and post_body() callbacks in uvm_sequence are explicitly bypassed when the sequence is executed as a child sequence via `uvm_do or `uvm_do_with. Use pre_start() / post_start() or body() instead.

rules.name: UvmPSequencerAbuse
rules.description: Using `uvm_declare_p_sequencer or accessing p_sequencer violates the Law of Demeter by tightly coupling the sequence data tier to physical sequencer component internals. Pass configuration down through sequence fields or uvm_config_db.

rules.name: SequenceAbortSafety
rules.description: Detects calls to start_item() in UVM sequences that can bypass finish_item() via early return or break statements. An aborted sequence without finish_item() permanently deadlocks the sequencer's grant-wait queue.

rules.name: EmptySequenceBody
rules.description: Detects sequence classes whose body() task contains no executable statements. Empty sequence bodies generate zero stimulus transactions.

rules.name: UncheckedGetResponse
rules.description: Flags calls to get_response() in UVM sequences. Calling get_response() requires the driver to actively provide response items; otherwise, the sequencer response FIFO remains empty and deadlocks simulation.

rules.name: SequencePriorityRange
rules.description: Flags sequence start() calls passing invalid negative priority values (< -1) which corrupt sequencer arbitration.

rules.name: SequenceItemDefaultNew
rules.description: Requires sequence item constructor new() to provide a default value for the string name argument to support UVM factory creation and cloning.

rules.name: SequenceBodyWithoutStartItem
rules.description: Flags calls to finish_item() inside uvm_sequence::body() that are not preceded by a corresponding start_item(). The UVM sequencer arbitration handshake strictly requires start_item() before finish_item().

rules.name: SequenceItemCreateWithoutType
rules.description: Flags sequence items created via direct new() inside sequence body(). Sequence items must be created via factory type_id::create() to allow testcase overrides.

rules.name: UncheckedPSequencerCast
rules.description: Flags unchecked $cast(p_sequencer, m_sequencer) calls in sequences that do not verify the return status.

rules.name: SequenceStartOnNullSequencer
rules.description: Flags sequence start(null) calls that start sequences without an attached sequencer handle.

rules.name: SequenceItemTypeCompatibility
rules.description: Statically verifies that transaction item types between uvm_driver#(REQ) and uvm_sequencer#(REQ) are type-compatible across connect_phase connections.

rules.name: ComponentNullParentInCreate
rules.description: Flags UVM component factory create calls passing 'null' as the parent handle, creating orphaned hierarchy nodes.

rules.name: UvmCreateStringMismatch
rules.description: String argument passed to type_id::create() must match the receiving variable name. Mismatched instance names break uvm_config_db hierarchy paths and targeted overrides.

rules.name: ConstraintNameSuffix
rules.description: Enforces a naming standard requiring all constraint blocks to end with '_c' suffix.

rules.name: ComponentNameMismatch
rules.description: Disallows passing hardcoded string literals to super.new() in uvm_component constructors. The constructor must forward the 'name' argument so the UVM factory can assign distinct instance names.

rules.name: UvmUnconnectedTlmPort
rules.description: Mandatory TLM ports and exports declared in uvm_component must be connected in connect_phase to prevent runtime fatal errors or null-pointer dereferences.

rules.name: UvmTlmTryGetUnchecked
rules.description: Flags calls to non-blocking TLM methods (try_get(), try_peek(), try_put()) where the boolean return status is ignored.

rules.name: UvmTlmPortSuffix
rules.description: Enforces standard UVM TLM port suffix naming conventions (_ap for analysis ports, _imp for imps, _export for exports, _port for ports, _fifo for TLM FIFOs).

rules.name: TlmTopologyChecker
rules.description: Performs cross-component elaboration topology checks to verify that mandatory TLM ports (such as driver seq_item_pull_port and monitor analysis_port) are bound in connect_phase across the verification environment hierarchy.

rules.name: AnalysisTransactionMutation
rules.description: Detects in-place modification of transactions received via analysis write() methods. Because analysis ports broadcast by reference, modifying transaction fields directly causes silent data corruption across other concurrent subscribers and scoreboards.

rules.name: AnalysisFifoDrainStarvation
rules.description: Detects instantiated uvm_tlm_analysis_fifo components that receive transactions via connect_phase but have zero drain operations (.get(), .try_get()) across all task-based phases, causing unbounded simulation heap memory growth and fatal bad_alloc crashes.

rules.name: CheckerCannotFail
rules.description: Flags scoreboard and checker classes with no way to report a failure: no `uvm_error or `uvm_fatal, no assertion and no comparator, in the class, its bases or the helpers it calls (Sonar S2699, tests without assertions).

rules.name: FixedDelayBeforeDrop
rules.description: Flags a constant #delay immediately before drop_objection(), used to let traffic drain (xUnit 'sleepy test', Sonar S2925).

rules.name: VirtualInterfaceModportDriveInversion
rules.description: Detects procedural signal driving (via '=' or '<=') on virtual interface handles inside passive uvm_monitor components. Monitors must remain purely passive observers to avoid multi-driver electrical contention and X-propagation.

rules.name: VirtualSequencerWiringChecker
rules.description: Statically verifies that sub-sequencer handles declared within a virtual sequencer are fully wired and assigned in connect_phase across the verification environment.
